en_title: Cyberpunk 2 Is Still a Ways Out, but CD Projekt Red Says Its RPGs Will Come Out Faster in the Future
cn_title: 《赛博朋克2》距离推出仍需一段时间，但CDPR表示未来旗下RPG的推出速度将加快
opus_summary: CDPR表示，《赛博朋克2》进展顺利，但尚无法确定进入全面制作的时间。公司称正并行开发多个项目，预计未来作品发行间隔将缩短；目前尚不清楚这一变化是否会影响《赛博朋克2》。

paragraphs.en: We are still two years out from The Witcher 4 , but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.
paragraphs.cn: 距离《巫师4》推出还有两年，但Ciri大展身手的冒险并不是CDPR正在制作的唯一一款大型RPG。听起来，《赛博朋克2》的开发进展顺利，尽管目前仍处于开发周期的非常早期阶段。

paragraphs.en: In a November 24 earnings call , CD Projekt Red VP of Strategy & Investor Relations Karolina Gnaś said the team is "making good progress with Cyberpunk 2, we are happy with where we are, but it's still too early to give a specific date and plan on when we will move onto full production." Although she couldn't provide a clear date when we'll hear more about the game, she did add that the studio plans to have around 200 developers by the end of 2026 and 320 by the end of next year.
paragraphs.cn: 在11月24日的财报电话会议上，CDPR战略与投资者关系副总裁Karolina Gnaś表示，团队「在《赛博朋克2》上取得了不错的进展，我们对目前的进度感到满意，但现在给出进入全面制作阶段的具体日期和计划还为时过早」。虽然她无法给出我们何时能听到更多游戏消息的明确日期，但她补充说，工作室计划到2026年底拥有约200名开发人员，到明年年底达到320人。

paragraphs.en: It is admittedly a bit early to expect any kind of information about the Cyberpunk sequel, but it has been simmering in the background since at least 2022 , and it sounds like CD Projekt Red wants to speed up development of its massive RPGs. In its consolidated earnings report , CD Projekt Red admitted that most of its games "normally take 3 to 6 years to produce," mostly due to working on one game at a time. But that strategy has since changed.
paragraphs.cn: 诚然，现在期待获得关于《赛博朋克》续作的任何消息还有点早，但这款游戏至少从2022年起就一直在幕后酝酿，而听起来CDPR希望加快其大型RPG的开发速度。在合并财报中，CDPR承认，其大多数游戏「通常需要3到6年制作」，这主要是因为公司一次只开发一款游戏。但这一策略此后已经改变。

paragraphs.en: In that same report, the company said, "At the moment, the CD Projekt Red studio is working in parallel on several productions (also in collaboration with external development teams) and supporting products, which is expected to translate into shorter intervals between the releases of subsequent titles in the future." Whether or not that new timeline will affect Cyberpunk 2 is the question.
paragraphs.cn: 在同一份报告中，该公司表示：「目前，CDPR工作室正在并行开发多个项目（其中也包括与外部开发团队合作的项目）及配套产品，预计这将缩短未来后续作品之间的发行间隔。」问题在于这一新的时间安排是否会影响《赛博朋克2》。

paragraphs.en: But even if that faster development timeline is in effect for Cyberpunk 2, it's likely we'll still have to wait a while to actually see it in the wild. In an earnings report last year, when Cyberpunk 2 entered pre-production, CD Projekt CEO Michał Nowakowski suggested that CDPR's games take four or five years to move from pre-production to release, which would put the game somewhere in 2030 or 2031. And given that the game still hasn't entered full production, it isn't likely we're going to see some sort of rapid release after the Witcher 4 in 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 但即便《赛博朋克2》采用了更快的开发时间安排，我们很可能仍需等待一段时间才能真正看到它推出。去年《赛博朋克2》进入预制作阶段时，CD Projekt首席执行官Michał Nowakowski在一份财报中表示，CDPR的游戏从预制作到发行需要四到五年，这意味着该游戏会在2030年或2031年的某个时候推出。考虑到游戏尚未进入全面制作阶段，它不太可能在2028年《巫师4》推出后很快发行。

paragraphs.en: We're probably going to be waiting a little while longer for Cyberpunk 2, but it's already sounding like the game is taking shape. Just last month, associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a lot of the developers working on Cyberpunk 2 are former modders. Sasko went on to claim that "the modding community is really keeping [Cyberpunk 2077] alive," so hopefully that energy translates to Cyberpunk 2 – whenever it comes out.
paragraphs.cn: 我们可能还要再等一段时间才能玩到《赛博朋克2》，但听起来这款游戏已经开始成形。就在上个月，副游戏总监Pawel Sasko透露，许多参与《赛博朋克2》开发的人员曾是模组制作者。Sasko接着表示，「模组社区确实让《赛博朋克2077》保持着活力」，因此希望这股活力也能延续到《赛博朋克2》中——无论它何时推出。
